@graph.name: Rajadamnern Knockout, Tuesday 29 September 2026
@graph.description: Seven three-round Muay Thai bouts bring Thai and international fighters to Rajadamnern Stadium on Tuesday 29 September 2026, with an action-focused format and Rajadamnern’s advertised 80% knockout rate.

mainEntity.name: What time does Rajadamnern Knockout start on 29 September 2026?

acceptedAnswer.text: Doors open at 18:00 and the first fight begins at 19:00 Bangkok time.
Rajadamnern Knockout is scheduled as seven three-round bouts.

mainEntity.name: What time will the event finish?

acceptedAnswer.text: The event normally finishes at approximately 21:00 to 21:30. The exact finishing time can vary according to the fights on the night.

mainEntity.name: Can I arrive after the first fight?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. The gates remain open during the evening, so guests may enter after the event has started.

mainEntity.name: Do I need to print my ticket?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. The QR ticket can be shown on your phone when entering the stadium.
Bookings of two or more assigned seats in one order are seated together. Unassigned seating categories do not have reserved individual seat positions.

mainEntity.name: Is Rajadamnern Knockout suitable if I have never watched Muay Thai?

acceptedAnswer.text: The three-round format is straightforward to follow for a first live Muay Thai event. Wai Kru, traditional music and full Muay Thai rules remain part of the evening, while the shorter fight format keeps each contest compact.
